literal.prompt: К рождению какого жанра Capcom приурочила 20-летие серии Resident Evil?

literalGroups.primaryGround: Capcom’s official retrospective calls the Resident Evil 20th anniversary the birth of survival horror and dates the original Japanese release to March 22, 1996. Spector’s account, RogueBasin and the Dota Auto Chess description establish the other choices as real genre terms with plausible examples.
literalGroups.locator: Capcom L5-L6; GDC pp.33-34/L2804-L2828; RogueBasin L17-L23; Steam L158-L160.

literalGroups.literal: Capcom приурочила 20-летие Resident Evil к празднованию «рождения survival horror». Первая игра серии вышла в Японии в марте 1996 года, поэтому правильный термин — survival horror.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Capcom’s retrospective explicitly frames the series anniversary as commemorating the birth of survival horror and dates the Japanese release to March 22, 1996.

literalGroups.literal: Уоррен Спектор описывал Deus Ex как сочетание immersive sim, ролевой игры, шутера от первого лица и приключенческой игры.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Warren Spector’s first-person Deus Ex postmortem identifies the game as part immersive simulation, part RPG, part FPS and part adventure.

literalGroups.literal: Rogue, вышедшая в 1980 году, дала название жанру roguelike.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The specialist RogueBasin entry states Rogue was published in 1980 and established the roguelike genre.

literalGroups.literal: В оригинале отряд S.T.A.R.S. Alpha Team переживает одну ночь в особняке Спенсера.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Capcom states that S.T.A.R.S. Alpha Team spent one night in Spencer Mansion; this adds a fact about Resident Evil beyond the prompt’s genre and year.

literalGroups.literal: В Dota Auto Chess выбранные герои автоматически сражаются на поле 8×8.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Steam retains a creator description stating that Dota heroes automatically fight on an 8×8 board. The Workshop item is marked removed and the attempted official alternative URL was an unrelated chess-program site, so source authority remains unresolved.
literalGroups.locator: Steam L15-L17 and L158-L160; alternative site L6-L16 is unrelated.
